By John Holland | The Oregonian/OregonLive Tonight’s college basketball slate features the No. 3 seed Gonzaga Bulldogs facing the No. 14 Kennesaw State Owls in this NCAA Tournament first-round showdown. The tip is scheduled for Thursday, March 19, at 7 p.m. PT / 10 p.m. ET (8 p.m. MT) with a live broadcast on TBS and streaming live on demand . Watch truTV streaming live Is the Gonzaga vs Kennesaw State NCAA Tournament game on TV today, or streaming only? What time does it start? When: Thursday, March 19, at 7 p.m. PT / 10 p.m. ET (8 p.m. MT) Where: Moda Center, Portland, OR TV Channel : TBS How can I watch March Madness basketball games streaming for free? How to watch streaming live without cable : There are several options to watch this game and more NCAA Tournament games this season. If you don’t already have cable, you can watch NCAA Tournament games live for free with DIRECTV (free trial). If you are all out of free trials or just need a streaming service to watch games all the way through the NCAA Tournament, Sling is the cheapest way to watch every tournament game (costs just $23 for the first month). However, if your TV doesn’t already have one built in, you will have to buy an HDTV antenna to pair with your Sling subscription to get the games being broadcast on your local CBS station. If you already have cable, you can watch every NCAA Tournament game live through the March Madness Live app when you sign in with your cable provider login information.
